sensitivePaths.label: Run a model (billed by the second)
Run a model (billed by the second)

agentGuide: Base path /v1. Run a model: POST /predictions {"version": "<version hash>", "input": {...}} or by name POST /models/<owner>/<name>/predictions {"input": {"prompt": "..."}} (add header Prefer: wait to get the output in one call when it finishes under a minute). The answer has id and status; poll GET /predictions/<id> until status is succeeded (output: a string, or URLs of files — fetch an image URL with save_as only if the host is allowed; otherwise give the URL). Cancel: POST /predictions/<id>/cancel. Find models: GET /models?... is not searchable here; GET /models/<owner>/<name> gives latest_version.id and the input schema (openapi_schema). Collections: GET /collections/<slug>. Account: GET /account. Every run is billed by the second. The token is set by Allkin.
